description: Run LitScout from a fixed checkout using the daily runbook.
args: Run LitScout by following `/ABSOLUTE/REPO/docs/runbook/daily.md` in self-host mode and pass `--config /ABSOLUTE/CONFIG/litscout.config.ts` to every LitScout command. Use pnpm to run the CLI. Use summaries run and digest run so the CLI applies its tool-less settings to the writing agents. End with the report as the final message.
